content: Everything checks out. The deprecated `legacy_export` handler is removed from `api/handlers.py` and no longer appears in `registry()`, while `ping`, `export_v2`, and `stats` (kept, since its deprecation is only a question mark and clients still call it) continue to work. The test suite passes.
